response.description: Announcing new capabilities in Azure Logic Apps that expand healthcare interoperability support through a rich set of connectors. The following connectors are now in public preview: HL7 connector: Enable seamless healthcare data exchange using HL7 messaging standards and BizTalk migrations. MLLP connector: Provides Minimal Lower Layer Protocol support for integration with healthcare systems, and BizTalk migrations, available in the Logic Apps Hybrid deployment model. These enhancements strengthen Azure Logic Apps as the foundation for enterprise-grade, event-driven, and healthcare-integrated workflows, bridging on-premises, cloud, and industry-specific systems with ease.
response.title: Public Preview: New healthcare connectors for Azure Logic Apps
